lead: 讲“决心”是什么、常见哪几类，以及大多数人为什么坚持不下来，最后给出守住决心的办法：定可实现的目标、拆成小目标、写下来、让家人朋友提醒你。全文 25 句、4 段，适合练“找原因 + 找建议”。原卷只有“选句填空”，本页 5 道理解题为依据原文自拟，仅供参考。
paragraphs: Do you know what a resolution is? A resolution is a promise that you make to yourself. People make resolutions to improve their life. The most common kind is a New Year's resolution. After all, the start of the year is often a perfect time for making resolutions.

Resolutions can be about anything. Some are about physical health. For example, some people may promise to exercise more or eat more healthily. Some resolutions have to do with learning new things. People might decide they are going to take up a hobby, like painting or photography. And some resolutions have to do with self-improvement, like becoming more confident or organized. For example, a student may decide to start a new study plan.

Although there are differences, most resolutions have one thing in common: People hardly ever keep them! But there are good reasons for this. Sometimes the resolutions may be too difficult to keep. And sometimes people just forget about them.

To make your resolutions work, you need to plan them wisely. Always make sure your resolution is possible to achieve. Don't set a goal that is too difficult or too much for you. Try to set mini-goals to help you achieve your resolution. And if you don't want to forget your resolutions, write them down. Also, talk about them with your family and friends. Encourage them to remind you of your goals. So what resolutions are you going to make? How are you going to keep them?

questions.q: What is a resolution according to the passage?

options.t: A promise you make to yourself

questions.evidence: A resolution is a promise that you make to yourself.
questions.evidenceZh: 细节题：第一段第二句直接给定义，B 是原句的同义复述。

questions.q: Why do most people fail to keep their resolutions?
questions.qZh: 为什么大多数人坚持不了自己的决心？

options.t: The resolutions are too hard or they forget them
options.tZh: 决心太难，或者他们忘了

options.t: They have no time at all
They do not like setting goals

questions.evidence: Sometimes the resolutions may be too difficult to keep. And sometimes people just forget about them.
questions.evidenceZh: 原因题：第三段连续两句给出两个原因——太难（too difficult）和忘记（forget），A 把两条合起来。

questions.q: What does the word "mini-goals" mean in the passage?
questions.qZh: 文中 mini-goals 这个词是什么意思？

options.t: Very big goals for the future
Small goals that help you reach your resolution
options.tZh: 帮你实现决心的小目标

questions.evidence: Try to set mini-goals to help you achieve your resolution.
questions.evidenceZh: 猜词题：mini-（小）+ goals（目标），且后半句 to help you achieve your resolution 说明了作用。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a kind of resolution?
questions.qZh: 下面哪一项不是文中提到的决心类型？
questions.evidence: Some are about physical health. / Some resolutions have to do with learning new things. / And some resolutions have to do with self-improvement, like becoming more confident or organized.
questions.evidenceZh: 细节题（否定问法）：第二段只提到 health / learning new things / self-improvement 三类，挣钱没提。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?

options.t: What resolutions are, why people fail, and how to keep them
options.tZh: 决心是什么、为什么坚持不了、怎样坚持

options.t: How to write a study plan

questions.evidence: To make your resolutions work, you need to plan them wisely.
questions.evidenceZh: 主旨题：全文先定义决心、再讲常见类型与失败原因，最后一段给坚持的办法；B、C、D 都只是文中一个例子。
